Summary: Healthcare RAG search vendor evaluating Redwood Private + Optimize for PHI-sensitive clinical doc search. CTO (Dr. Anika Rao) emphasized strict audit trails and field-level redaction; want routing/fallback by region and cost tier.

Recent activity:
- 2025-01-12: Intro call w/ Maya (AE) + Lucas (SE) — overview of Redwood runtime, basic SLAs. CTO asked for HIPAA/HIPAA BA considerations.
- 2025-01-28: Product demo + POC kickoff (Fireflies ff_2025_01_28_pulsevault_poc_demo). Ingest sample EMR dump (~18M notes; 120GB compressed). Discussed sharding strategy for indexes.
- 2025-02-01: Security sync — pulled security FAQ, asked about KMS/HSM integration and customer-managed keys.
- 2025-02-10: Latency targets call (ff_2025_02_10_security_sync) — stated p95 < 120ms, p99 < 250ms for single-turn clinical QA queries; throughput target 400 qps during batch hours.
- 2025-02-15: POC milestone 1: embeddings pipeline prototype complete (open-source model quantized). Evaluating vector DB choices and local reranking approach.

Requirements / priorities (customer voice):
- Indexing scale: must support 10-30M documents with incremental ingestion and per-patient partitioning.
- Embeddings: prefer deterministic embeddings with versioning; need ability to re-embed subsets when models changed.
- Reranking: neural reranker after candidate retrieval to surface latest clinical notes; must run within tail-latency budget.
- Cost sensitivity: want cost model that isolates expensive rerank ops to a small fraction of traffic, automatic routing to cheaper baseline models under heavy load.
- Security/compliance: mandatory HIPAA BA, SOC2 Type II, SSO/SAML, KMS with CMK, detailed immutable audit logs for every document access, per-user access controls, data residency US-only.
- Networking: VPC peering or private link; air-gapped option for research environment considered but not required for initial rollout.

POC plan / success criteria:
- Ingest 18M-note sample into a scaled index and demonstrate 99th percentile query latency <250ms with reranker on 10% of queries.
- Show cost per query breakdown in Console (token, rerank CPU, storage) and ability to enforce budget caps.
- Security sign-off: pass customer security questionnaire + provide SOC2 report + KMS integration test.
- Canary: 2-week canary on dedicated capacity with per-route tracing.

Quotes / call snippets:
- "We need to prove we can return the right note fast — clinicians won't wait more than a few hundred ms." — Dr. Anika Rao, CTO.
- "If reranking doubles cost but halves false positives, we need to see the ROI in unit economics." — Head of Data Eng.

Open technical questions:
- Which vector DB to pair for 30M vectors: prefer managed vs self-hosted; tradeoffs on cold-start and burst throughput.
- Reranker placement: run as part of runtime or as sidecar? implications for tail latency and batching.
- Incremental re-embedding strategy and schema for field-level PHI redaction.
